links.outcome: Agreement of GPT data entry with human rater reference standard across iterations
links.effect: Fourth iteration agreement 93.6%; 2247 of 2400 items correct, 153 (6.4%) incorrect; range 62% to 100% across patients; early iterations scored as low as 0.26.
links.quote: Of 2400 individual items assessed, our model entered 2247 (93.6%) correctly and 153 (6.4%) incorrectly.

unlisted_practices: Iterative domain-specific prompt engineering with ontological guidance to improve LLM data abstraction accuracy for research registries

screen.reason: The study evaluates an offline LLM's accuracy across iterative prompt engineering for data extraction into a clinical registry compared to human ratings, but does not test a deployment practice/guardrail.
